name: Jennifer Thompson
summary: Strategic HR leader with 10+ years of experience driving organizational transformation and talent strategy. Proven expertise in building scalable HR infrastructure, enhancing employee engagement, and aligning people operations with business objectives across technology and Fortune 500 companies.

education.degree: Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (MILR)

points: Lead HR operations for 850+ employee technology company, managing team of 8 HR professionals across talent acquisition, employee relations, and compensation
Reduced time-to-hire by 40% through implementation of structured interview process and applicant tracking system optimization
Increased employee retention rate from 78% to 91% through enhanced onboarding program, career development pathways, and competitive compensation analysis
Designed and launched company-wide performance management system using Workday, improving goal alignment and increasing engagement scores by 35%
Spearheaded DEI initiative resulting in 60% increase in diverse candidate pipeline and establishment of 4 employee resource groups
Partnered with C-suite executives and department heads supporting 500+ employees across Engineering, Sales, and Operations
Led organizational restructuring initiative affecting 200+ employees, ensuring smooth transitions and maintaining 95% retention of key talent
Developed leadership training program that improved manager effectiveness scores by 42% and reduced employee complaints by 30%
Managed annual compensation cycle with $45M budget, conducting market analysis and ensuring internal equity while staying within budget
Managed full-cycle recruitment for professional and technical roles, filling 120+ positions with 92% hiring manager satisfaction rate
Administered benefits programs for 300+ employees, achieving 98% enrollment completion and reducing benefits costs by 12%
Conducted workplace investigations and resolved employee relations issues, maintaining compliance with federal and state regulations
Created HR metrics dashboard providing leadership with real-time insights on turnover, hiring, and engagement trends

projects.title: HRIS Implementation
projects.description: Led selection and implementation of Workday HRIS system, migrating 850+ employee records and integrating payroll, benefits, and performance management modules. Project completed 2 weeks ahead of schedule with zero data loss.
projects.tech: Project Management, Vendor Management, Change Management

projects.title: Remote Work Policy Development
projects.description: Designed comprehensive remote work policy and hybrid workplace guidelines during pandemic transition, achieving 89% employee satisfaction while maintaining productivity and collaboration standards.
projects.tech: Policy Development, Stakeholder Management, Communication Strategy
